title: Insulin Pump Program Desk Reference: Cartridge and Reservoir Refills
content:
**What it is.** A cartridge or reservoir refill on an Insulin Pump Program is a refill shipment, made at the customer's request, of the cartridge or reservoir item the pump uses — the A4232 reservoir for a MiniMed 780G, the A4225 cartridge for the other models — drawing billing units from one authorization grant of the program and shipped by standard ground carrier.

**When it ships.**

- The cartridge refill is not shipped until the program's past-due amount the patient-balance postings show, after leaving out any balance an approved payment plan covers, is below the tier's past-due hold minimum. On a tier whose past-due hold days are 0, the refill is never held for a past-due balance.
- For a cartridge or reservoir refill, and only for such a refill, the customer's refill confirmation is taken on the day the refill ships: on a tier that requires refill confirmation, the cartridge refill ships only after the customer personally confirms on that day, for this shipment, that they are still using the cartridges and how many they have on hand, and that day is the refill's confirmation date; an infusion-set refill keeps the confirmation its own refill rule sets, and every other refill of the program keeps the general confirmation rule.

In other words, the refill stays unshipped while the past-due amount shown by the patient-balance postings, once any balance an approved payment plan covers is left out, is at or above the tier's past-due hold minimum.

**Tool card — `ship_cartridge_refill_a415cb78`**

*Capability.* Ships one cartridge or reservoir refill package on an insulin pump program by standard ground carrier. The call books one refill shipment line for the cartridge or reservoir item, drawing the shipped billing units from the named authorization grant: the program's authorized units remaining go down by the units shipped, and the shipment line records the confirmation date the customer gave, the days of supply and the billing route. Each cartridge or reservoir is one billing unit and one physical piece. The customer sees a new refill shipment on the program with today's ship date.

*Invocation.* Agent-side: the representative unlocks `ship_cartridge_refill_a415cb78` and then calls it.

*Parameters.*

- `pump_program_id` — the reference number of the customer's insulin pump program, read from the pump program lookup.
- `customer_id` — the reference number of the customer who holds the program, read from the customer profile lookup.
- `coverage_id` — the reference number of the insurance coverage record the program bills, read from the pump program lookup or the coverage lookup; an empty string on the self-pay tier.
- `pump_order_id` — the reference number of the authorization grant record the refill draws on, read from the pump order lookup for the program.
- `previous_pump_shipment_id` — the reference number of the program's latest earlier refill shipment line of the same item, read from the pump shipments lookup; an empty string when the item has never shipped on the program.
- `item_code` — the cartridge or reservoir item shipped: `A4225` is the syringe-type cartridge used by Tandem t:slim X2, Tandem Mobi and Beta Bionics iLet pumps; `A4232` is the reservoir used by the MiniMed 780G pump; `E0784` is the pump itself, `A4224` is the infusion-set supply and `A4239` is the pump-integrated sensor allowance, none of which is a cartridge or reservoir line.
- `units` — the cartridges or reservoirs shipped, an integer number of billing units (one per cartridge or reservoir), which is also the count of physical pieces in the package, zero or more.
- `supply_days` — the days of supply the refill covers, an integer number of calendar days, a multiple of 30.
- `refill_confirmed_date` — the calendar date the customer confirmed continued use and supply on hand for this refill, YYYY-MM-DD; an empty string only on a tier that requires no refill confirmation.
- `billing_route` — `payer_claim` when the program bills an insurance coverage by claim; `self_pay` when the program is on the self-pay tier and the customer pays the Larkfield cash price.

*Return.* A receipt with `pump_shipment_id` (the new refill shipment line), `item_code`, `units`, `supply_days`, `ship_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), `authorized_units_remaining` (the program's units still available after this refill) and `status` (the value shipped when the line is booked).
